The '''Saeduree River Shipping Tower''', often abbreviated as the '''SRS Tower''', was a massive tower located in the [[City/Legends|City]] of [[Capra]], and was the largest building in the city. It was made of metal that was designed to mimic the [[silvergrass]] that covered much of [[Kinyen/Legends|Kinyen]].<ref name="Strongholds" />
